audience.text: Rust developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx files without relying on Microsoft Office or Aspose.Cells Enterprise Edition.

capabilities.text: Load and save Excel .xlsx files from paths, streams, or in-memory bytes with repair options and structured diagnostics.
capabilities.title: Read and write XLSX files

capabilities.text: Read and write typed cell values including strings, numbers, booleans, dates, and formulas with cached results.
capabilities.title: Cell value management

capabilities.text: Apply comprehensive cell styling including fonts, fills, borders, number formats, and alignment via CellStyle and StyleFlag.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Manage worksheets including adding, renaming, hiding, protecting, and setting visibility, tab color, and zoom.
capabilities.title: Worksheet management

capabilities.text: Enforce data validation rules and apply conditional formatting including color scales, data bars, icon sets, and formula-based rules.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Create charts of multiple types and embed pictures and drawing shapes including preset auto shapes.
capabilities.title: Charts and shapes

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended document properties, apply workbook and worksheet protection, and manage freeze panes and page setup.
capabilities.title: Document properties and protection

capabilities.text: Apply auto-filters with complex criteria including color, custom, dynamic, top 10, and sort conditions, plus build structured Excel tables.
capabilities.title: Auto-filters and tables

limitations.text: Supports only .xlsx (OOXML/SpreadsheetML) format; no legacy .xls, ODS, or CSV handling.
No automated test suite is present; cargo test --all-targets reports 0 tests.
Not yet published to crates.io; installation requires Git or path dependencies.
WorksheetsMut::remove_at returns an error when attempting to remove the last remaining worksheet.

problems_solved.text: Enables pure-Rust Excel file processing without requiring Microsoft Office installation or proprietary Aspose runtime.
Provides structured diagnostics for repairing malformed XLSX files during load operations.
Supports full OOXML packaging including ZIP container, relationships, shared strings, styles, and charts.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust is a pure-Rust library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without external dependencies or proprietary runtimes.

workflows.name: Load and repair XLSX
workflows.text: Load an XLSX file with repair options via LoadOptions and inspect structured diagnostics via Workbook::get_load_diagnostics.

workflows.name: Write typed cell values
workflows.text: Write values of various types using CellMut::put_value_* methods and formulas with cached results via put_formula_with_cached_value.

workflows.name: Apply cell styling
workflows.text: Apply styling via CellStyle with Font, Fill, Borders, and NumberFormat, using StyleFlag for targeted updates.

workflows.name: Build charts and tables
workflows.text: Create charts via ChartCollection and structured tables via ListObjectCollection with totals and table styles.

workflows.name: Save XLSX output
workflows.text: Save workbooks to file, stream, or in-memory bytes using Workbook::save_xlsx, save_xlsx_to_stream, or save_xlsx_to_bytes.
